title: Riley
creator: CrossFit
description: Run 1.5 miles, 150 burpees, run 1.5 miles, ideally in a vest, for time. Honours U.S. Army Special Forces Sgt. 1st Class Riley G. Stephens, killed by small-arms fire in Wardak, Afghanistan, in 2012. Nothing technical, just long; pace the first run.
